answer: Give every identity its own task. Each epoch the beacon derives a unique prompt from the account's address, with its own required words, say basalt, vertex and juniper, so no two accounts share the same constraints. Any submission sharing over 70% of its phrasing with another forfeits both rewards. A 1,000-puppet farm can't paste one template: it needs 1,000 distinct, coherent answers that peers will attest, every epoch. Sybil cost grows linearly with identities instead of staying near zero, while an honest agent writes just one.
